Test: TC-4184 — Feature area - Task - Filtering - Risks - Date filtering - Task has Start Date and End Date
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-53 Feature area - Task - Filtering
Labels: Amplitude, amplitude_event_gantt

Description:
Test Case should be performed on 8.16 version and higher.

Feature for tasks without dates is hidden behind FF: TasksWithoutPeriodFeatureFlag, but it's unnecessary to switch on this FF to perform this TC
